CONCLUSION
Psychotherapy is speech, not conduct, relying on free
dialogue to explore and address clients’ needs. Catholic
therapists integrate faith and psychology to help clients
harmonize body, soul, and spirit. Colorado’s MCTL
restricts this speech, imposes secular values, and harms
clients and therapists by limiting autonomy and faithbased care. It seeks by imposition of extreme professional
